question_text: In Barangay San Isidro, a dispute arises between neighbors Juan and Pedro over a minor property boundary issue. The Punong Barangay, Maria Santos, calls for a meeting under the Katarungang Pambarangay system. Which of the following best describes the role of the Punong Barangay in this process?

options.text: She acts as a judge who issues a binding decision that can be appealed to the Regional Trial Court.
She serves as a mediator who facilitates a settlement, and if no settlement is reached, she may issue a summons for the parties to appear.
She has no role; the dispute must be referred directly to the Municipal Trial Court.
She appoints a panel of elders to decide the case, and she enforces their decision.
